description: This file is a PHPUnit test class for validating image aspect ratio rules in the OrangeHRM Corporate Branding API plugin. It tests various scenarios to ensure the validation logic correctly enforces specific aspect ratios for images, such as SVG and PNG files.

classes.name: ImageAspectRatioTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class that verifies the functionality of the ImageAspectRatio validation rule in various scenarios. It simulates image validation with different aspect ratios, file types, and content to ensure correctness.

methods.name: testValidate
methods.description: Performs unit tests on the validate method of the image aspect ratio rule, using data provided by the dataProvider method. Checks whether images of specified ratios and types pass or fail validation.

methods.name: dataProvider
methods.description: Provides a set of test data arrays containing aspect ratio, filename, file type, base64 content, and expected validity results to drive parameterized tests for varying image validation scenarios.
